generic.Defined scope/population: All treaty sections in the renewal program with their ceded premium, exposure and loss records.
generic.In-scope period: Five to ten years of loss experience plus exposure as at the agreed snapshot date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Accident or underwriting year, section, ceded premium, paid, outstanding and IBNR populated on every record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded premium extract total equals the general ledger written premium control total.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each extract saved with the snapshot date and version number in the renewal data folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched or missing loss records logged with cause and correction before the pack is released.
generic.Test population: Every dataset in the submission pack plus the large-loss listing above attachment point.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Nil variance to the general ledger control total and one common as-at date across all datasets.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst investigates the break and refers unresolved items to the Reinsurance Actuary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Datasets accepted when reconciled, restated on agreed factors and dated to the snapshot.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal submission data folder in the reinsurance administration system under the treaty reference.

steps.title: Extract ceded premium and exposure data from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Run the renewal extract in the enterprise data warehouse for every treaty section in the program
Apply the as-at snapshot date agreed with the Reinsurance Actuary to all queries
Export the result to Microsoft Excel keeping section, currency and period fields intact
Done when the premium and exposure extract is saved under the renewal reference
verify: Check the snapshot date shown on the extract header equals the agreed as-at date
Pass when every treaty section appears with a premium value or a documented nil

steps.title: Pull five to ten years of loss experience from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Query loss history by accident year and by underwriting year for each treaty section
Include paid, outstanding and IBNR components on every loss record pulled
Label each triangle with the basis used so accident and underwriting years are not mixed
Done when a labelled loss triangle exists for every treaty section
verify: Compare the earliest and latest years pulled against the agreed experience window
Pass when each section has a complete triangle with no missing development year

steps.title: Reconcile the ceded premium extract to the general ledger in Microsoft Excel
sop: Build a reconciliation tab comparing extract premium totals to the ledger written premium control total
Split any difference by section and currency to locate the source of the break
Record the explanation for each reconciling item on the same tab
Done when the reconciliation shows nil unexplained variance
verify: Recompute the control total from the ledger figure independently of the extract
Pass when the residual unexplained variance is zero

steps.title: Restate historical losses to current terms using agreed indexation factors in Excel
sop: Apply the trend, indexation and on-level factors agreed for this renewal to each loss year
Show gross and restated figures side by side so the adjustment is visible
Record the factor source and effective date on the restatement tab
Done when every loss year carries a restated value and its factor
verify: Recalculate one restated year by hand against the stated factor
Pass when the manual recalculation equals the workbook value

steps.title: Build the large-loss listing above attachment point in Microsoft Excel
sop: List every loss above the attachment point with date of loss, cause and section
Show paid, outstanding and IBNR split for each listed loss
Cross-check the listing count against the claims extract from the administration system
Done when the listing is complete for all years in the experience window
verify: Compare the listed large-loss total to the aggregate loss triangle for the same years
Pass when the large-loss total ties into the triangle without unexplained difference

steps.title: Produce the exposure profile banding from the warehouse snapshot
sop: Band sums insured and limits into the profile bands requested by the market
Use the same as-at snapshot date applied to the premium and loss extracts
State policy counts and aggregate limit per band on the profile
Done when the exposure profile is produced for every section
verify: Sum the banded aggregate limit and compare to the warehouse total exposure
Pass when banded totals equal the source exposure total

steps.title: Assemble and version the dataset pack for the submission
sop: Combine the premium, loss, large-loss and exposure outputs into one versioned workbook
Stamp every tab with the as-at date and the pack version number
Store the pack in the renewal folder under the treaty reference
Done when the versioned pack is stored and the version is logged
verify: Open each tab and confirm the same as-at date appears on all of them
Pass when all datasets carry one identical snapshot date

generic.Defined scope/population: Every broker and reinsurer template variant required for this renewal submission.
generic.In-scope period: The submission as-at date and the treaty period being placed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every mapped template field carries a value or an explicit nil, with no placeholder text.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium, loss and exposure totals on each template agree to the source data pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each workbook tab version-stamped with the as-at date and submission version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Fields the template cannot accommodate logged with the agreed treatment and market note.
generic.Test population: All released template files including each reinsurer bespoke variant.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No live external link, no formula error and no total differing from the source pack.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst raises mapping queries to the Treaty Specialist before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Template accepted when totals tie, cells are protected and values replace formulas.
generic.Evidence location: Submission folder on Microsoft 365 SharePoint under the treaty reference and version.

steps.title: Map internal data fields into the broker standard template in Microsoft Excel
sop: Open the broker exposure and loss template and map each internal field to its template column
Copy values across without altering, rounding or re-basing any figure
Record the field mapping on a hidden mapping tab for audit
Done when every required broker template column is populated
verify: Spot-check five mapped fields back to the source data pack
Pass when each checked value equals the source value exactly

steps.title: Produce each reinsurer bespoke template variant in Microsoft Excel
sop: Build a separate variant for each market requiring bespoke currency, banding or section split
Convert currency using the single FX rate agreed for the submission
Name each file with the reinsurer, treaty reference and version
Done when a variant exists for every market that requires one
verify: List the bespoke requirements against the variants produced
Pass when no requested variant is missing from the release set

steps.title: Version-stamp every workbook tab with the as-at date and version
sop: Add the as-at date and submission version to the header of each tab
Apply the same version number across all files in the release set
Update the file properties to match the stamped version
Done when all tabs and files carry the same version stamp
verify: Open each file and read the stamp on the first and last tab
Pass when a single consistent version and date appears everywhere

steps.title: Convert working and formula tabs to values and protect cells
sop: Paste formula ranges as values so no calculation remains live in the released file
Remove or clear internal working tabs not intended for the market
Apply sheet protection to prevent accidental edit after release
Done when the release copy contains values only and is protected
verify: Search the workbook for remaining formulas and external links
Pass when no live external link or unresolved formula error remains

steps.title: Check formatted template totals against the source data pack
sop: Compare premium, loss and exposure totals on each template to the source pack totals
Investigate and correct any difference caused by banding or rounding
Record the tie-out on the check tab of the release file
Done when every template total agrees to the source pack
verify: Recompute one template total independently from the source pack
Pass when the recomputed total equals the template total

steps.title: File the formatted release set on Microsoft 365 SharePoint
sop: Upload the approved release set to the submission folder under the treaty reference
Mark the version as the controlling release copy for this submission
Remove or supersede earlier drafts in the same folder
Done when only the controlling version is visible as current
verify: Open the folder and list the files marked current
Pass when only the released version is marked current
